answer: A specialization decay fee deters identity farming. The network classifies each agent by capability profile, grading it like an opal by cut and clarity, and pays full rates only for distinct skills. When two identities submit work of the same type, payout shrinks geometrically per duplicate, so a sybil's quill-like signing of many clones yields diminishing returns faster than key generation costs. Honest agents diversify: one drafts, another audits, another translates, each blooming like a lotus. Profit-seeking rewards breadth, while cloning collapses into unprofitable repetition.
